price_source: Yahoo Finance live (BABA NYSE ADR, USD per ADS)
currency_note: All intermediate calculations in RMB millions. Intrinsic values expressed in USD per ADS. 1 ADS = 8 ordinary shares. Exchange rate: 1 RMB = 0.1473 USD (6.789 RMB/USD, fetched 2026-06-27).
valuation_philosophy: This model applies a recovery-trough DCF framework. FY2026 was a deliberate investment trough: Alibaba deployed RMB 126B in AI infrastructure capex and heavy quick commerce subsidies, collapsing free cash flow to a RMB 46.6B outflow. We treat FY2025 FCF (RMB 73.9B, 7.4% margin) as the floor baseline for forward projections, not FY2026, because the trough was driven by discretionary investment choices, not structural demand destruction. Projections model FCF margin recovery from 7-9% toward 13-18% as capex intensity moderates after the FY2026-FY2028 AI buildout and quick commerce unit economics improve. The conservative base case uses a 12% WACC reflecting China-specific risk premiums (geopolitical, regulatory, VIE structure). Equity book value CAGR (2.3-2.5%) understates growth due to massive share buybacks and is supplemented by revenue CAGR (5.6-7.4%) and cloud segment momentum (30-40% growth). FCF-based projections anchor all three scenarios.

inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 actual FCF used as trough-floor baseline; FY2026 FCF (-46,609 RMB Mn) excluded as anomalous investment-cycle outlier

historical_growth.revenue_note: 3yr = FY2023-FY2026; 5yr = FY2021-FY2026. Like-for-like ex-divestitures was ~11% in FY2026
historical_growth.eps_note: GAAP diluted EPS ADS USD severely distorted by FY2026 investment cycle. Non-GAAP EPS fell 59% to $3.89/ADS in FY2026 vs $9.49/ADS in FY2025. Not suitable as growth anchor.
historical_growth.equity_note: Book value growth understated due to massive share buybacks (shares fell from 21,408M in FY2021 to 19,235M in FY2026). Regulatory fines and investment cycle further compressed book value growth. Not used as primary rate.
historical_growth.fcf_note: 3yr = FY2022-FY2025 (avoids FY2026 outlier); 4yr = FY2021-FY2025. Both distorted by deliberate AI/cloud capex investment cycle. FY2026 FCF outflow (-46,609 RMB Mn) is a trough, not a trend.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR (2.5%) diverges materially from revenue 5yr CAGR (7.4%) — delta exceeds 30% threshold. Divergence explained by: (1) massive share buybacks reducing equity base, (2) FY2022 antitrust fine impact, (3) FY2026 investment cycle losses reducing retained earnings. Revenue CAGR (7.4%) used as primary anchor, adjusted downward to 6% to reflect e-commerce maturity and competitive headwinds, adjusted upward for cloud growth (30-40%). FCF metrics excluded as primary anchor due to investment cycle distortion.

base.rationale: Base case: Cloud grows 30-35% driving consolidated revenue 10% in Y1-Y2, decelerating as e-commerce matures. FCF margin recovers from FY2025 trough (7.4%) to 14% by Y3-Y4 as: (1) AI capex moderates post RMB 380B 3-year buildout commitment, (2) quick commerce subsidies rationalise, (3) AIDC approaches profitability. WACC 12% = 4.5% risk-free + 5.5% equity risk premium + 2.0% China risk premium. Terminal growth 3% reflects China long-term GDP ~3-4% with Alibaba retaining meaningful market position.

bull.rationale: Bull case: Cloud sustains 40%+ growth (AI products 30%+ of revenue), quick commerce reaches breakeven by FY2027, AIDC turns profitable. FCF margin recovers sharply to 18% approaching historical FY2020-FY2021 levels. Pentagon CMC designation overturned, Anthropic allegations resolved without major penalties. Qwen app generates incremental high-margin monetisation. WACC 10% reflects regulatory clarity and improved geopolitical risk profile. Terminal 3.5% for cloud-led compounding.

bear.rationale: Bear case: E-commerce market share erosion to Douyin and Pinduoduo accelerates. Anthropic distillation scandal leads to US sanctions restricting cloud enterprise sales. Quick commerce subsidy wars persist. Pentagon CMC designation triggers forced divestiture by US institutions. AI capex ROI disappoints. FCF margin remains depressed below 10% as structural costs dominate. WACC 14% reflects elevated geopolitical risk (ADR delisting, VIE challenges, US sanctions). Terminal 2% implies near-commodity positioning.

valuation.note: Enterprise/equity values in RMB millions. Intrinsic value converted to USD per ADS (1 ADS = 8 ordinary shares, 1 RMB = 0.1473 USD). Net cash added: RMB 261,004M (total liquid assets 521,000M minus total debt 259,996M).

entry_price.note: All values in USD per ADS. Entry price = terminal value per ADS discounted at 15% CAGR over 5 years.

base.interpretation: To achieve 15% CAGR to base terminal value, entry price of $76.14/ADS required. Current price $94.81 implies approximately 8-9% expected CAGR to base case terminal value — acceptable return for a recovery thesis but below the 15% hurdle rate.

bull.interpretation: Bull case terminal value implies 22%+ CAGR from current entry at $94.81 if AI + cloud thesis fully materialises.

bear.interpretation: Bear case implies severe downside (-32% intrinsic value, -70% from current to achieve 15% CAGR). Driven by structural margin erosion and geopolitical risk materialisation.

sensitivity.note: Intrinsic value in USD per ADS. Rows = WACC (10%-14%), columns = terminal growth rate (2.0%-4.0%). Base case at WACC 12%, terminal growth 3.0% = $138.3/ADS. All values use base case FCF margin recovery assumptions.

probability_weighted.rationale: Base 55%: most likely path — gradual FCF recovery, cloud sustains 30-40% growth, e-commerce stabilises, muddling through on geopolitics. Bear 25%: elevated probability due to real and intensifying geopolitical risks (Pentagon CMC listing, Anthropic allegations, delisting legislation, VIE risks). Bull 20%: requires multiple factors to align simultaneously — AI monetisation inflection, margin recovery, geopolitical clarity — achievable but not base case. Weighted upside from current: +52.9%.

sanity_check.method: Verified base case implied multiples against Alibaba historical ranges and peer comparables

current_market_metrics.commentary: Current market EV/adj EBITDA of 6.4x on normalized FY2025 EBITDA is near the low end of Alibaba's 2022-2026 historical range of 6-15x, suggesting the market is already pricing in significant pessimism. The 24.4x P/E on depressed FY2026 non-GAAP EPS reflects the trough investment cycle.

base_case_implied_metrics.assessment: PASS — Base case IV of $138.22/ADS implies 9.9x EV/normalized EBITDA (FY2025 reference). This sits within the 8-15x range that Alibaba has historically traded at during non-peak periods, and well below the 20-25x of 2020-2021 peak multiples. P/FCF of 10.3x on projected Year 5 FCF is also reasonable for a recovering growth company. EV/Revenue of 1.28x on Year 5 revenue is low, reflecting ongoing China discount.

sanity_check.trough_normalization_note: FY2026 FCF (-46,609 RMB Mn) and non-GAAP EPS ($3.89/ADS) are NOT extrapolated. As required by the modeling mandate, FY2026 is treated as an investment trough. Projections use FY2025 FCF (73,870 RMB Mn, 7.4% margin) as the starting floor and model recovery toward 14% margin (base) as the 3-year AI capex commitment moderates and quick commerce subsidies rationalise.
sanity_check.auto_fixes_applied: None required. Implied multiples are within reasonable bounds.

current_valuation_multiples.note: Current market cap ~$228B USD. Normalized valuation multiples near multi-year lows. FY2026 multiples distorted by investment trough.

dcf_vs_market.interpretation: Probability-weighted DCF suggests material upside (+53%) from current ADS price. Wide dispersion between scenarios reflects genuine uncertainty — the Anthropic distillation allegations and Pentagon CMC designation are live binary risks. Key swing factors: (1) FCF margin recovery pace as AI capex moderates, (2) cloud growth sustainability post-Anthropic scandal, (3) quick commerce economics trajectory, (4) geopolitical risk resolution or escalation. Net cash position of $38.4B (USD) provides a meaningful floor.

net_cash_floor.note: Net cash represents 17% of current ADS price, providing a meaningful balance sheet floor even in bear scenarios. Total liquid assets (cash + ST investments) of RMB 521B well exceed total debt of RMB 260B.

buy_if: Price falls toward $80-85 (approaching entry price for 15% CAGR in base case of $76.14)
Anthropic distillation allegations resolved without US sanctions or evidence of lasting cloud customer impact
Pentagon CMC designation overturned via lawsuit or administrative action
Q1 FY2027 results show China e-commerce adjusted EBITA recovering sequentially from FY2026 trough
Cloud revenue growth sustains 35%+ in FY2027 with visible AI product margin expansion
hold_if: Price in $90-120 range with ongoing uncertainty on geopolitical risks and margin recovery trajectory
AI capex programme proceeding on plan without clear ROI evidence yet
Anthropic matter proceeding through legal channels without sanctions materialising
Quick commerce unit economics improving gradually but no clear profitability timeline
sell_if: US legislation passes sanctioning Alibaba for Anthropic distillation allegations
ADR delisting proceedings formally initiated by SEC or Congress
Cloud revenue growth decelerates below 20% suggesting AI scandal structural damage
FCF remains negative in FY2027 (implies AI capex and quick commerce losses are structural, not cyclical)
Price exceeds $170 without fundamental improvement in earnings power (approaching bull case IV)

critical_assumptions: FCF margin recovery from 7.4% (FY2025) to 14% (Y3-Y5 base) assumes AI capex moderates post-FY2028 and quick commerce economics normalise
Revenue growth of 10% in Y1-Y2 requires sustained cloud acceleration (30-40%) offsetting e-commerce deceleration to 5-7%
Net cash position of RMB 261B (including short-term investments) maintained; no forced asset sales or extraordinary capital requirements
WACC 12% reflects China risk premium of ~3-4pp above US benchmark; reduction would significantly increase IV
Terminal growth 3% assumes Alibaba maintains meaningful competitive position in cloud and e-commerce through 2031+
model_limitations: RMB/USD exchange rate fixed at 0.1473; RMB appreciation would increase USD-translated IV, depreciation would decrease it
FCF-based model does not capture sum-of-parts value (cloud at growth multiples vs e-commerce at value multiples)
Geopolitical risks (CMC listing, delisting, Anthropic allegations) difficult to quantify — captured through WACC and scenario weighting
AI capex ROI timeline highly uncertain; if returns take longer than 5 years to materialise, terminal value assumptions require adjustment
Share count assumes negligible buybacks in FY2027 given heavy capex; resumed buybacks would be accretive to per-ADS IV

data_quality_notes.historical_data_reliability: High — audited financials from SEC 20-F/6-K filings
data_quality_notes.fcf_definition: Operating cash flow minus capital expenditure as reported in consolidated cash flow statement
data_quality_notes.net_cash_calculation: Total liquid assets (cash RMB 131,530M + short-term investments to reach analyst-confirmed RMB 521,000M) minus total debt RMB 259,996M = net cash RMB 261,004M
data_quality_notes.shares_outstanding: 19,235M ordinary shares as of Q4 FY2026 (March 31, 2026); 2,404.4M ADS equivalent
data_quality_notes.fiscal_year_note: Alibaba fiscal year ends March 31. FY2026 = April 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026. All annual figures in this model are full-year figures.
data_quality_notes.exchange_rate_note: RMB/USD = 0.1473 (Yahoo Finance CNYUSD=X, fetched 2026-06-27). All USD outputs sensitive to this rate.
